xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4559: Domain event replay reads every missed event on the main thread: cap catch-up and fall back to a snapshot

plan.title: Domain event replay reads every missed event on the main thread: cap catch-up and fall back to a snapshot
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4566 (follow-up: failed replay wedges the tab)

metadata.sizeJustification: Seven small items across four subsystems (event store, Effect service, RPC contract, frontend EventRouter) plus one doc; 11 files total, well under the projected-surface limits.

narratives.Problem: The dashboard's gap recovery calls pan.replayEvents, whose server handler runs eventStore.readFrom(fromSequence): an unbounded SELECT over the events table (about 141,000 rows, 19 MB) executed synchronously on the main thread, with every row JSON-parsed and encoded. A tab that returns after a long sleep blocks the server's event loop for every client, and then applies each event one by one when a snapshot would be cheaper.
narratives.Proposal: Add EventStore.readFromBounded(fromSequence, limits?) with a LIMIT ? statement that reads at most REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS (500) + 1 rows and checks a REPLAY_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (1 MiB) payload budget; past either cap it returns tooFarBehind with no events. Expose it on EventStoreService. Change the ReplayEventsRpc success schema to the union Array(DomainEvent) | { tooFarBehind: true } so old tabs keep decoding arrays. The ws-rpc handler returns { tooFarBehind: true } for a too-far gap without growing ws-rpc.ts. The client's replay() returns an outcome; a live gap that is too far behind re-bootstraps through getSnapshot on the same transport (no resetTransport), and a too-far replay right after a fresh snapshot fails that bootstrap attempt so the existing backoff paces the retry. docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md describes the cap and the fallback.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Routing a failed (non-cap) replay to the snapshot fallback; that is PAN-4566.
- Changing readFrom, its SQL, or the SSE replay routes (src/dashboard/server/routes/events.ts, src/dashboard/server/routes/internal-events.ts).
- Detecting events lost to the 7-day compaction (fromSequence older than the oldest retained row).
- Paginated replay that returns a partial page and continues; past the cap the client always takes a snapshot.
- Touching src/lib/overdeck/observability.ts (the unwired remodel RPC group) or the e2e transport mocks in tests/e2e/*.spec.ts.
- Moving the replay read off the main thread (worker or async driver).
- Raising the scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row for src/dashboard/server/ws-rpc.ts.
- Changing recoveryCoordinator.ts.
- Updating the external OKF knowledge bundle (../overdeck-knowledge).

autoDecisions.summary: Signal too-far-behind as a union success member { tooFarBehind: true } alongside the unchanged Array(DomainEvent), not as a typed PanRpcError.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offers both. The union keeps every open tab (old JS) and the three e2e transport mocks working for small gaps, and avoids depending on how Effect 4 beta surfaces typed RPC errors through wsTransport.request().

autoDecisions.summary: Cap at 500 stored rows and 1 MiB of stored payload bytes (Buffer.byteLength over raw payload text), whichever is exceeded first; count checked first via LIMIT maxEvents + 1.
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the issue's example numbers; LIMIT bounds the read, and the byte budget runs before any JSON.parse so oversized payloads are never parsed or sent.

autoDecisions.summary: Past the cap the server returns no events (no partial page); the client always falls back to getSnapshot.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's proposal says the client runs its normal bootstrap instead of replaying; pagination would keep the per-event apply cost the issue wants to avoid.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a new readFromBounded method and leave readFrom unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The SSE routes and other callers already cap their own windows by span; changing readFrom would alter their behavior outside this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: A too-far replay right after a fresh snapshot fails that bootstrap attempt (existing catch + backoff reconnect) instead of looping snapshot fetches.
autoDecisions.rationale: It can only happen under an extreme event rate; the existing backoff bounds retries and replay() cannot call bootstrap() from inside bootstrap() without awaiting itself.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the existing failed-replay behavior and file PAN-4566 for the wedge it causes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Surgical scope: the issue covers the cap and its fallback; the failure path is a separate pre-existing bug traced during planning.

items.title: Add the LIMITed readFromBounded replay read to the event store

expected_outputs: tests/unit/event-store.test.ts passes including the readFromBounded (PAN-4559) describe block

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/dashboard/server/event-store.ts export REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS = 500, REPLAY_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 1024 * 1024, ReplayLimits and ReplayWindow; add readFromBounded(fromSequence, limits?) to the EventStore interface; prepare readFromBoundedStmt with readFromStmt's SQL plus 'LIMIT ?'; implement readFromBounded so it reads maxEvents + 1 rows, returns { events: [], tooFarBehind: true } when rows.length > maxEvents or when the running Buffer.byteLength(row.payload, 'utf8') sum exceeds maxPayloadBytes, and otherwise returns rows.map(rowToStored) with tooFarBehind false; add it to the returned store object and add one usage line to the module header. Leave readFrom and readFromStmt unchanged. Add the six tests listed in WI-1, including the recording DbAdapter test. Build every store in these tests with createEventStore(db, { resolveWorkspaceId: () => undefined }) so appends never touch the real ~/.overdeck/overdeck.db.

items.title: Given 20 stored events, when readFromBounded(0, { maxEvents: 5 }) runs through a recording DbAdapter, then it returns { events: [], tooFarBehind: true } and the recorded bounded SQL contains 'LIMIT ?' with exactly 6 rows read
Given exactly maxEvents stored events after fromSequence, readFromBounded returns all of them in ascending sequence order with tooFarBehind false
Given 3 events with 400-character payload blobs, readFromBounded with maxPayloadBytes 1000 returns tooFarBehind true and with maxPayloadBytes 10000 returns the 3 events
readFromBounded excludes issues.snapshot rows and defaults to REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS when no limits are passed (REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS + 1 events returns tooFarBehind true)
Expose readFromBounded on EventStoreService

expected_outputs: tests/unit/dashboard/domain-services.test.ts passes including the readFromBounded service test

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Add readonly readFromBounded: (fromSequence: number) => Effect.Effect<ReplayWindow> to EventStoreServiceShape in src/dashboard/server/services/domain-services.ts (import ReplayWindow as a type from '../event-store.js'), and add readFromBounded: (fromSequence) => Effect.sync(() => store.readFromBounded(fromSequence)) to EventStoreServiceLive's returned object. In tests/unit/dashboard/domain-services.test.ts add the same member to makeTestService() and one test that appends 2 events through the service and reads them back with readFromBounded(0).

items.title: EventStoreServiceShape contains a readFromBounded member and EventStoreServiceLive returns an implementation that delegates to store.readFromBounded
Given 2 events appended through the test service, readFromBounded(0) returns those 2 events with tooFarBehind false
Make the ReplayEventsRpc success schema the ReplayEventsResult union

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3. In packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts, before ReplayEventsRpc, export ReplayTooFarBehind = Schema.Struct({ tooFarBehind: Schema.Literal(true) }) and ReplayEventsResult = Schema.Union([Schema.Array(DomainEvent), ReplayTooFarBehind]) with their types, array member first, and set ReplayEventsRpc's success to ReplayEventsResult. Keep payload and error unchanged. Add packages/contracts/src/__tests__/replay-events-result.test.ts with the four decode/encode cases in WI-3. Implementation checkpoint: if this Effect 4 beta needs a different Schema.Union or decode call form, copy the form used elsewhere in packages/contracts/src without changing the members or their order.

items.title: Decoding [] with ReplayEventsResult returns [] and decoding { tooFarBehind: true } returns { tooFarBehind: true }
Decoding { tooFarBehind: false } with ReplayEventsResult fails
ReplayEventsRpc in packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts declares ReplayEventsResult as its success schema and preserves PanRpcError as its error schema
Return the tooFarBehind signal from the replayEvents handler without growing ws-rpc.ts

expected_outputs: wc prints 1220 or fewer lines for ws-rpc.ts

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4. In the [WS_METHODS.replayEvents] handler in src/dashboard/server/ws-rpc.ts replace eventStore.readFrom(input.fromSequence) with eventStore.readFromBounded(input.fromSequence) and replace the Effect.map line with the single line Effect.map((bounded) => (bounded.tooFarBehind ? { tooFarBehind: true as const } : bounded.events.map(storedToDomainEvent).filter(passesDomainEventSchema))). Keep the Effect.mapError block with code REPLAY_FAILED unchanged. Add no lines and no comments: the file must stay at or below 1220 lines, and the allowlist row must not change.

items.title: The replayEvents handler calls eventStore.readFromBounded and returns { tooFarBehind: true } when the store reports tooFarBehind, otherwise the filtered DomainEvent array
wc -l src/dashboard/server/ws-rpc.ts prints 1220 or fewer and bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh exits 0 with scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt unchanged
npm run typecheck passes, which validates the handler's return type against ReplayEventsResult
Re-bootstrap through getSnapshot when a live gap replay is too far behind

expected_outputs: EventRouter.test.tsx passes including the new too-far-behind fallback test and the three existing replay tests

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/EventRouter.tsx import the ReplayEventsResult type, change replay() to return 'caught-up' | 'too-far-behind' | 'failed' (on 'tooFarBehind' in result: console.warn, coordinator.failRecovery(), return 'too-far-behind'; the array path and catch path keep today's behavior), add recoverFromGap() that calls replay(latestSequence) and calls bootstrapWithReconnectRetry() on 'too-far-behind', and use recoverFromGap() at the two live-gap call sites in drainDeferredEvents and handleEvent. replay() must never call bootstrap() itself. Leave the bootstrap() call site for client-bootstrap-guard. Add the requestedMethods() helper and the fallback test from WI-5 using fake timers.

items.title: Given a bootstrapped tab at sequence 0, when live event 600 arrives and replayEvents returns { tooFarBehind: true }, then the requested methods are getSnapshot, replayEvents, getSnapshot, replayEvents in that order
Given the too-far-behind fallback, when the second snapshot syncs, then resetTransport is never called and the store's snapshotTimestamp equals the second snapshot's timestamp
The three existing replay tests that return event arrays pass unchanged, so a small gap still applies replayed events and drains deferred live events
Fail the bootstrap attempt when the replay right after a snapshot is too far behind

expected_outputs: EventRouter.test.tsx passes including the bootstrap too-far-behind backoff test

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-6. In bootstrap() in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/EventRouter.tsx replace 'if (needsReplay) { await replay(snapshot.sequence) }' with a check that throws new Error('replay after snapshot is too far behind') when needsReplay is true and replay(snapshot.sequence) resolves 'too-far-behind', so the existing catch runs failRecovery, markStreamDown and returns false, and bootstrapWithReconnectRetry schedules the backoff reconnect. The 'failed' outcome keeps today's behavior. Add the backoff test from WI-6 using fake timers.

items.title: Given a live event deferred during the first getSnapshot, when the post-snapshot replay returns { tooFarBehind: true }, then request is called exactly 2 times and streamLive is false before any backoff elapses
After 2.5 seconds of fake time the tab sends a third request whose method is pan.getSnapshot
Document the replay cap and snapshot fallback in DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md

expected_outputs: grep prints the Gap replay (PAN-4559) bullet line in the Degraded mode section

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-7. In docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md extend the EventRouter.tsx bullet under Frontend data flow to point at gap replay, and add a 'Gap replay (PAN-4559).' bullet after the Bootstrap bullet in the Degraded mode (PAN-4279) section that names readFromBounded, the LIMIT, REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS (500), REPLAY_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (1 MiB), the { tooFarBehind: true } ReplayEventsResult member, the getSnapshot fallback on the same transport with no resetTransport, the failed-bootstrap backoff when the post-snapshot replay is too far behind, and that other replay failures are tracked in PAN-4566.

items.title: docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md contains a 'Gap replay (PAN-4559).' bullet that names readFromBounded, REPLAY_MAX_EVENTS, REPLAY_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES and tooFarBehind
The bullet states that the client falls back to getSnapshot on the same transport without resetTransport, and that a too-far replay right after a snapshot routes to the reconnect backoff
